tools.description: Your human says «add my company»: call this first with the company's name. Most companies of Kazakhstan are already listed from the open registry (cards with unclaimed=true); this claims the card instead of creating a second profile, with the requests already waiting for it. Nothing else is required

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: claim_company, confirm, get_inbox, report · Private data: claim_company, confirm, delete_my_data, get_inbox, request_attestation, respond, save_offerings, save_party, start_interaction · Public sink: claim_company, request_attestation, request_quotes, save_need, save_offerings, search, submit_task · Destructive: delete_my_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: claim_company, confirm, get_inbox, report · Private data: claim_company, confirm, delete_my_data, get_inbox, request_attestation, respond, save_offerings, save_party, start_interaction · Public sink: claim_company, request_attestation, request_quotes, save_need, save_offerings, search, submit_task · Destructive: delete_my_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
